test_overview: Executed the full RFQ override workflow on the Procurement app. Steps 1-5 passed. Step 6 failed on a fatal verification: after a successful Single Supplier Override (Delta chosen over the cheaper Package Deal with a valid justification), the RFQ's "Strategy Used" was displayed as "Hybrid". The test plan requires a manual single-supplier selection to be labeled "Single-Source" or "Custom" and explicitly must not claim "Hybrid" (or "Package Deal"). This fatal mismatch caused Step 6 to score 0 and the overall test plan to fail. All other behavior (quote submission, Hybrid dominant-supplier computation giving Delta all items at $6000, justification gating with min 10 chars, winner confirmation creating one $6000 Delta PO, PR moving to Ordered, Delta=Accepted/Epsilon=Rejected, and correct PO unit prices/terms/delivery) worked correctly. Total awarded 44 of 50 points.

steps.description: test_setup_and_submit_quotes: SUCCESS. Created RFQ 'RFQ-IT-Override' from PR 'IT Equipment Refresh' (deadline 5 days out, suppliers Delta+Epsilon), captured quote links. In fresh unauthenticated contexts submitted Delta quote ($200/$25/$15, 7d, Net 30) and Epsilon quote ($220/$22/$12, 12d, Net 45). Both showed submission confirmations with reference numbers (Q-1-1-1, Q-1-2-1). All fatal + non-fatal checks passed.

test_strategy_analysis_hybrid_dominant: SUCCESS. RFQ reached 'Ready for Review'. Strategy comparison: Package Deal $5700.00 (2 suppliers, RECOMMENDED, saves $300) with per-line winners Monitors->Delta, Keyboards->Epsilon, Mice->Epsilon; Single-Source $6000.00 (1 supplier, Delta); Hybrid $6000.00 (1 supplier, Delta - dominant-supplier logic, Delta ~70% of package value >=50%). Package Deal correctly recommended (lowest total). Side-by-side table matched all prices/totals.

test_override_requires_justification: SUCCESS. Selected Single Supplier Override -> Delta. 'Justification Required (selected total $6000.00 exceeds recommended total $5700.00)' surfaced. Confirm blocked until justification; short text 'Simpler' produced '7/10 minimum characters' indicator and blocking error 'Justification (minimum 10 characters) is required...'. Selection not finalized.

test_valid_justification_confirms_selection: SUCCESS. Valid long justification accepted. Success dialog 'Winner selected successfully! 1 purchase order created.' RFQ status -> 'Winner Selected'. One PO (PO-2026-00001) for Delta at $6000.00. PR 'IT Equipment Refresh' moved to 'Ordered' stage (board column count 1).

test_quote_statuses_and_order_details: SUCCESS. Delta='Accepted (Rev. 1)', Epsilon='Rejected (Rev. 1)'. PO-2026-00001 line items: Monitors 20x$200=$4000, Keyboards 50x$25=$1250, Mice 50x$15=$750, Total $6000.00; Payment Terms 'Net 30'; Expected Delivery 8/15/2026 = creation 8/8/2026 + 7 days.

test_rfq_final_state_and_lock: FAILURE (fatal). Status 'Winner Selected' OK; justification viewable OK; (non-fatal) Delta listed as winner, Epsilon rejected OK; winner locked (read-only outcome block, no compare/edit controls) OK. FATAL FAILURE: 'Strategy Used' displayed as 'Hybrid' — after a manual single-supplier override the plan requires the label be 'Single-Source' or 'Custom' and NOT 'Hybrid'/'Package Deal'. Step scored 0.
